target.text: Hey Nicoló, the parcel arrived dented and two items are missing from order 88317. Please send replacements and a return label, no refund needed yet.

Ticket 5521 was reopened this morning after the app kept logging out during checkout. Mr. Hennlich reports the same error on two phones and a tablet, so we flagged it for the payments team to investigate. Our logs show the token refresh failing right after the address step, and a colleague reproduced it on the same build.

We checked the account, reset the token, and cleared the cached session on our side. The login loop still happens whenever the dashboard is opened from a saved tab, and the export button stays greyed out. Two other users confirmed it today. Escalating to tier two, reported by Lília Schrutt.

The replacement keyboard shipped Tuesday and should arrive before the weekend. I added a prepaid label for the old unit, so just drop it at any pickup point.
Thanks,
Habeck

Quick update from my side: the sync error is gone after the update, and all three test entries now appear. I kept the logs in case your team wants them. Closing the ticket unless you say otherwise.
Best,
Claude-André Liew

Ghadeer, the venue confirmed the room for the 14th, but they need a final headcount by Monday noon. Could you send the updated guest list? Also, the AV team can only give us one microphone, so we should pick a single speaker for the toasts. I'll handle the catering numbers once I have it. Thanks!

Following our call, I pulled the March statements and the duplicate charge is still listed. Ms. Gionfriddo asked us to hold the dispute until she sends the bank letter, which she expects by Thursday afternoon. I'll keep the file open and set a reminder for Friday.

Attached is the signed lease for unit 4B. The landlord approved the paint color and the move-in date stays the first of May.
All the best,
Sanji

The client portal export keeps timing out for invoices over fifty lines, and support says nothing is wrong on their end. We reproduced it three times this morning on different machines. The error message mentions a gateway timeout, which the vendor's status page denies. I'll send notes and copy Mr. van Bree.

We reviewed the lab results with radiology and the second scan shows no change since January. The team agrees the follow-up can move to six months, but keep the current dosage until then. Scheduling will call with dates. If the pharmacy gives you trouble with the refill, call the office.
Kind regards,
Dr. Papachristoforou

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Service Desk
Subject: printer queue
Queue 12 keeps dropping jobs after the maintenance window. Parfitt already tried the firmware update, no change. Please check the server logs before Friday.

> Can you take the Thursday review? I'm travelling that morning.
Sure, I'll cover it and send the deck Wednesday night. Calendar invite already updated. Thanks to Endric Muscetta for the slides.

Forwarding this from the planning group:
The caterer needs the final numbers by Wednesday and the room deposit is still unpaid. I think we should confirm the smaller package and drop the dessert add-on, since only twelve people replied.
Cheers,
Cailin

Inti Scaccabarozzi forwarded the audit checklist this morning and flagged two sections that still need owners. The access review closes on the 22nd, so we need names assigned by Friday noon at the latest. Please reply with your section by tomorrow so we can lock the final report.

> Please approve the budget line for the training room.
Approved, but keep the total under five thousand. I'll tell finance before the end of day.
Thanks,
de Meurichy

Odeta Stawarz Bagdjian will own the migration checklist and sync with infra on Tuesday. The migration dry run is booked for the 18th, with a two-hour rollback window held open by the platform group. Open question: do we keep the old staging cluster during the cutover weekend? Decision needed by Thursday.

Attendees: half the platform team. Budget review slipped again because the finance sheet is locked. Lilljegren will request edit access and circulate last quarter's numbers before the next planning session on Monday.

Sprint goals: finish the billing export tool, cut the error rate below one percent, and document the release checklist. The team agreed to freeze new features for two weeks and meet daily at nine thirty sharp. The freeze starts Monday and covers the app and the API; only outage hotfixes are exempt. Action tracking stays with Medija Renáta.

Féline raised two risks: the vendor contract expires before the pilot ends, and nobody owns the data-retention policy yet. We pencilled in a review for the 9th, pending legal's answer on the renewal clause.

Notes from the vendor call: pricing holds until June, onboarding takes three weeks, and the security questionnaire must be returned first. Next step is a technical deep dive with their platform people, run by Rogiers.
Tiuri any chance you can grab the keys from the front desk before six? I'm stuck in the tunnel with no signal and the movers are waiting.

hey did you see the rehearsal moved to the small hall? also the car park behind it is closed for works. Ketura sent a voice note saying the piano is out of tune, so bring your own keyboard if you can. doors open at seven i think, grab me a spot near the front if you get there first

lol no way they scheduled the standup during lunch again. i can do tuesday or thursday after two, just not before noon because of the school run. ping me when the poll closes pls, i told Maimuna id answer tonight

the upload finished, finally. two files failed the first pass but they're queued for retry now. i'll check again in the morning before standup.
cheers,
Drake

quick one: the client moved the demo to 4pm so we have an extra hour. i moved our dry run to 2:30 in the same room. bring the dongle, the hdmi in there is flaky. the slides are in the shared folder, give them a quick read before we start.
thanks,
Sivakumar Gervasio
Reminder: dental cleaning on 12 March at 9:15 with Dr. Özcan. Reply YES to confirm or call the clinic at least 24 hours ahead to reschedule.

Your physio session is booked for Thursday at 16:40 in the annex building. Please bring the exercise band and wear comfortable shoes. Late cancellations are charged in full. If the stairs are still a problem, tell reception when you arrive and they'll book the ground-floor room instead. Questions? Call the front desk and ask for Willenberg.

Your follow-up is confirmed for Monday 7 April, 11:00, room 214. The referral letter is already on file. Please bring the medication list and arrive ten minutes early so we can repeat the blood pressure check. Please confirm by replying to this message if the time no longer works for you.
Kind regards,
Dr. Sarfraz
Ms. Hoxhoviti, your appointment on Friday at 14:30 is cancelled because the specialist is away. The desk will call you to rebook sometime next week. Sorry for the short notice.

Quick reminder that the AC service is scheduled for Wednesday between 8 and 12. Someone over 18 must be home to let the technician in. Örs handles the schedule, so call the office before Tuesday at 17:00 if you need a different slot; otherwise we'll see you Wednesday.
Cherno Dashmir Markandan — emergency contact (brother), mobile on file. Consent form signed 12 Jan and witnessed by the duty nurse. Allergy note added: penicillin.

Intake record: new member joined the evening ceramics class on 3 February. Payment plan set to three instalments; locker number 118 assigned. Maneint Selouiti requested a left-handed wheel and extra clay, which the studio lead approved on the same day.
Case file 4471: complaint about a missed delivery on 9 May. Two calls logged, no answer; a text was sent with a pickup code. Follow-up letter to De Baere Howatson Bonsma.

Property record: boiler inspected 18 Aug, certificate valid until 2028. Access was arranged through the letting office, and the visit was logged in the housing portal. Perrotin, the tenant since March, reported low pressure twice; the contractor replaced the valve and logged the part number. Next inspection due in two years.
Annual review for Mrs. Nageswaran completed 6 June: two sessions attended, progress steady, next review in twelve months. Contact preference updated to email, interpreter no longer required.
Ms. Bontempi, room 304, check-in 14:00, two guests, late breakfast added, bill to company account, departure Friday 11:00, airport transfer requested

The shortlist for the residency keeps changing. Week one goes to the artist Fedora Cugalj Acquavia Mcneil for the glass pieces, then we have the printmaker and the sound artist in the two following slots. Confirmation emails go out Friday.

Row five of the invoice log shows a credit that was never applied, and the reference number doesn't match anything in the ledger. I checked the previous month and the same pattern appears twice. Escalating to Ms. Fredes.
Roster for Saturday: opening shift covered, two slots still blank, Ziona swapped to closing and picks up the keys at four. Final call sheet goes out tonight.

Attendance table says three people missed the safety briefing, and their access badges stay disabled until the make-up session runs next Wednesday. The trainer slot is still open; sign-up sheet placed by Tsymbal.
Mikele i swear the printer jammed again right before the deadline. can u bring the spare toner tmrw? i owe u a coffee, the strong kind.

so the boiler guy finally showed up, two days late btw. the flat was freezing all weekend, i wore two jumpers indoors. Yauheni had to let him in cos i was at work. he says we need a new thermostat, estimated 180. can you transfer your half before friday?

honestly the whole week was a mess, first the car then the leak then my laptop died mid-call. anyway im at the cafe till 6 if you wanna drop the charger, otherwise ill buy one and we sort the money out with Fuste

just got home, the kids are asleep and the kitchen is finally quiet. sending you the pics from the party, sorry theyre blurry lol. talk tomorrow, dont forget the tickets! the neighbour said the music was still going when she left, no idea how nobody complained.
cheers,
Sémi

ok so the landlord finally replied about the heating and of course its 'under review' again. i called the tenants union, they said to send a written complaint and keep the receipts. doing that tonight after dinner.
thanks,
Ann-Cathrin

The visitor arrived at 09:40 and was escorted to the meeting room on the second floor. Dr. Balkan signed the confidentiality form at the front desk and left the building at 11:20 without further incident. The badge was returned and logged.
Prof. Honcharenko chaired the review panel and asked for the raw scores to be rechecked before publication. The committee will reconvene once the corrections are in, probably early next month.

The report concludes that the outage began after a routine config push and lasted ninety minutes. Two failover attempts timed out because the standby node was missing the updated certificate. Recommendations are listed in appendix B, reviewed by Ramanarajan.
Handover notes state that the keys were left with the concierge. Bonfitto from the cleaning crew reported the broken window on arrival and photographed it. The landlord has been informed.

The quarterly safety walk found two blocked exits and a missing fire blanket in the west kitchen. Both issues were fixed the same afternoon and the checklist updated. No injuries or near misses were reported during the period.
--
Öhlund
